source.description: A trusted Master Electrician in Auckland. Backed by a $20k Workmanship Guarantee, $5m Public Liability Insurance, and 12+ years of experience.
source.content:
An Electrician that you can rely on.
★★★★★ from 66 customers
Certified expertise. Exceptional results.
I’m a Master Electrician with the qualifications, experience, and commitment to deliver safe, reliable, and top-quality electrical work every time. When you choose me, you’re choosing peace of mind and exceptional results.
Areas we serve
Neon Electrical provides trusted electrical services Auckland-wide. As a qualified and experienced electrician Auckland homeowners and businesses rely on, we’re based in Otahuhu and proudly serve the wider region. Whether you need a quick repair, a safety upgrade, or a full renovation, our team delivers reliable, high-quality work across South, East, West, and Central Auckland.
South Auckland
Otahuhu, Mangere, Papatoetoe, Manukau, Flat Bush, Manurewa, Takanini, and Wiri.
East Auckland
Howick, Pakuranga, Botany Downs, East Tamaki, Bucklands Beach, and Dannemora.
Central Auckland
Onehunga, Ellerslie, Mount Wellington, Penrose, Remuera, Newmarket, and Parnell.
West Auckland
Henderson, Te Atatu, Massey, Glen Eden, Titirangi, and New Lynn.
North Shore
Takapuna, Albany, Glenfield, Northcote, Milford, and Devonport.
